Most of what appears on a CV is a highlight reel — the papers that were accepted,
the grants that were funded, the positions that were offered. It hides the far
longer list of rejections and setbacks behind every success. Inspired by the idea
of a *"CV of failures,"* this page keeps that longer list visible: the rejected
manuscripts, the unfunded proposals, the missed opportunities, and what each one
taught me.

::: {.callout-note appearance="simple"}
This page is a work in progress — the detailed entries will be added over time.
:::
